comment: Ballistic Dynamics cartridges: a projectile and its published muzzle velocity with the barrel it was measured in.

cartridges.name: .308 Win Federal Gold Medal Match 175 gr SMK (GM308M2)

provenance.muzzle_velocity_fps: published: Federal Premium catalogue, GM308M2, 2600 fps
provenance.test_barrel_in: published: Federal Premium ballistics are from a 24 in test barrel for .308 Win
provenance.velocity_sd_fps: estimated: match factory ammunition typically chronographs 8 to 15 fps SD
provenance.temp_coefficient_fps_per_f: estimated: an IMR 4064-class extruded powder, not sold as temperature-stable: about 1.5 fps per F
provenance.temp_reference_f: estimated: 70 F, the middle of SAAMI's 70 ± 10 F velocity-test conditions; the maker does not state the powder temperature of its figure
provenance.charge_gr: estimated: 175 gr .308 Win loads take about 42 to 44 gr of an IMR 4064-class powder in the handloading manuals; Federal does not publish its charge
provenance.gas_velocity_fps: estimated: the conventional powder-gas exit speed in free-recoil calculations for rifle cartridges, 4,700 fps; the true jet speed follows the muzzle pressure
